3553-memoirs-of-napoleon-bonaparte-volum.description: A book by Louis Antoine Fauvelet De Bourrienne. There shall be in each province an aga of the Janizaries,  maintaining constant communication with the French commandant. He  shall have with him a company of sixty armed natives, whom he may  take wherever he pleases, for the maintenance of good order,  subordination, and tranquillity.

arxiv-2101-11055.title: LDLE: Low Distortion Local Eigenmaps
arxiv-2101-11055.creator: Dhruv Kohli, Alexander Cloninger, Gal Mishne
arxiv-2101-11055.description: Abstract We present Low Distortion Local Eigenmaps (LDLE), a manifold learning technique which constructs a set of low distortion local views of a dataset in lower dimension and registers them to obtain a global embedding. The local views are constructed using the global eigenvectors of the graph Laplacian and are registered using Procrustes analysis.

arxiv-2108-03556.title: Relative Rota-Baxter operators and symplectic structures on Lie-Yamaguti algebras
arxiv-2108-03556.creator: Yunhe Sheng, Jia Zhao
arxiv-2108-03556.description: Abstract . In this paper, first we introduce the notion of a quadratic Lie-Yamaguti algebra and show that the invariant bilinear form in a quadratic Lie-Yamaguti algebra induces an isomorphism between the adjoint representation and the coadjoint representation. Then we introduce the notions of relative Rota-Baxter operators on Lie-Yamaguti algebras and pre-Lie-Yamaguti algebras.

arxiv-2311-03765.title: Classification of Various Types of Damages in Honeycomb Composite Sandwich Structures using Guided Wave Structural Health Monitoring
arxiv-2311-03765.creator: Shruti Sawant \affilnum 1, Jeslin Thalapil \affilnum 1, Siddharth Tallur \affilnum 1, Sauvik Banerjee \affilnum 2 and Amit Sethi \affilnum 1
arxiv-2311-03765.description: Abstract Classification of damages in honeycomb composite sandwich structure (HCSS) is important to decide remedial actions. However, previous studies have only detected damages using deviations of monitoring signal from healthy (baseline) using a guided wave (GW) based structural health monitoring system. Classification between various types of damages has not been reported for challenging cases.

arxiv-2312-10397.title: On the Validity of the Weak Value Approximation
arxiv-2312-10397.creator: Benjamin Noë Bauml
arxiv-2312-10397.description: Abstract The weak value approximation has been in use for thirty-five years, but it has not as of yet received a truly complete derivation, leaving its mathematical validity in a state of limbo. Herein, I fill this gap, deriving the weak value approximation under the von Neumann and qubit probe models.

arxiv-2402-05588.title: Quark-hadron duality and the determination of α s \alpha_{s} from hadronic τ \tau decay: facts v ​ s . {\mathit{v}s.} myths
arxiv-2402-05588.creator: Diogo Boito, Maarten Golterman, Kim Maltman, Santiago Peris
arxiv-2402-05588.description: Abstract Non-perturbative effects have a small but non-trivial impact on the determination of the strong coupling from hadronic τ \tau decay data. Several approaches have been proposed to take these into account, the two most important of which are the “truncated OPE” approach and “DV-model” approach.

arxiv-2407-16611.title: Local vs Global continual learning
arxiv-2407-16611.creator: Giulia Lanzillotta, Sidak Pal Singh, Benjamin F. Grewe, Thomas Hofmann
arxiv-2407-16611.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Giulia Lanzillotta, Sidak Pal Singh, Benjamin F. Grewe, Thomas Hofmann. Continual learning is the problem of integrating new information in a model while retaining the knowledge acquired in the past. Despite the tangible improvements achieved in recent years, the problem of continual learning is still an open one. A better understanding of the mechanisms behind the successes and failures of existing continual learning algorithms can unlock the development of new successful strategies.

arxiv-2511-03019.title: SLIP: Structural-aware Language-Image Pretraining for Vision-Language Alignment
arxiv-2511-03019.creator: Wenbo Lu
arxiv-2511-03019.description: Abstract Vision–Language Pretraining (VLP) has achieved remarkable success across various downstream tasks, but such gains are largely driven by scaling up on training data. Yet, literature methods treat image-text pairs as isolated training examples; this neglects the rich relational structure naturally present in many domains, such as e-commerce product co-purchase graphs and social recommendation networks.

pmc-10719241.title: Sustainable oil palm trunk fibre based activated carbon for the adsorption of methylene blue
pmc-10719241.creator: Muniandy Gayathiri, Thiruchelvi Pulingam, K T Lee, Azam Taufik Mohd Din, Akihiko Kosugi, Kumar Sudesh
pmc-10719241.description: Activated carbon (AC) is becoming the limelight due to its widespread application as an adsorbent for wastewater treatment, gases, and catalysis. However, its high consumption and price have drawn more attention to the sustainable use of natural resources as precursor for AC production.

pmc-11431706.title: Qualitative Analysis of Student Reflections on Preclinical Dental Implant Education
pmc-11431706.creator: Hassan Ziada, Michael Webberson, Rassilee Sharma, Neamat Hassan Abubakr, Claude Jaquiéry
pmc-11431706.description: Dental implant education is required to prepare students for independent general practice. This investigation aimed to assess students’ perceptions of their educational experience and training in a preclinical dental implant introduction course, using reflective logs anonymously extracted from course portfolios.

pmc-11543784.title: Accurate Measurement of Cell Number–Normalized Differential Gene Expression in Cells Treated With Retinoic Acid
pmc-11543784.creator: Nina Weichert-Leahey, Mark W. Zimmerman, Alla Berezovskaya, A. Thomas Look, Brian J. Abraham
pmc-11543784.description: Genome-wide gene expression analysis is a commonly used method to quantitatively examine the transcriptional signature of any tissue or cell state. Standard bulk cell RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) quantifies RNAs in the cells of the tissue type of interest through massive parallel sequencing of cDNA synthesized from the cellular RNA.

pmc-11655179.title: Scoliosis instrumentation alters primary and coupled motions of the spine: An in vitro study using entire thoracolumbar spine and rib cage specimens
pmc-11655179.creator: Christian Liebsch, Peter Obid, Morten Vogt, Benedikt Schlager, Hans‐Joachim Wilke
pmc-11655179.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundEffects of rigid posterior instrumentation on the three‐dimensional post‐operative spinal flexibility are widely unknown. Purpose of this in vitro study was to quantify these effects for characteristic adolescent idiopathic scoliosis instrumentations.MethodsSix fresh frozen human thoracic and lumbar spine specimens (C7‐S) with entire rib cage from young adult donors (26–45 years) without clinically relevant deformity were loaded quasi‐statically with pure moments of 5 Nm in flexion/extension, lateral bending, and axial rotation.

pmc-12631761.title: Clinical application of metagenomic next-generation sequencing in the diagnosis of severe pneumonia pathogens
pmc-12631761.creator: Raojuan Huang, Ying Zhang, Caitao Dong, Jingdi Chen, Handong Zou, Yang Liu, Mengmeng Guo, Hang Gao, Quan Ke, Wei Wu
pmc-12631761.description: BackgroundSevere pneumonia is a significant cause of mortality among ICU patients. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) is an advanced, comprehensive, unbiased diagnostic tool for pathogen identification in infectious diseases. This study aimed to evaluate the clinical efficacy of mNGS for diagnosing severe pneumonia.

pmc-12721110.title: Emergency superficial temporal artery–superior cerebellar artery bypass for hyperacute basilar artery occlusion following elective middle cerebral artery aneurysm clipping: illustrative case
pmc-12721110.creator: José Luis Andrade Valencia, Wojciech Czyżewski, Kohei Yoshikawa, Rokuya Tanikawa, Nakao Ota
pmc-12721110.description: BACKGROUNDBasilar artery occlusion (BAO) is a threatening condition requiring rapid reperfusion to preserve brainstem function. Although endovascular thrombectomy is considered standard treatment, underlying pathology or limited resources may require surgical intervention. The authors performed an emergency superficial temporal artery–superior cerebellar artery (STA-SCA) bypass in the hyperacute setting of BAO following elective aneurysm surgery.

pmc-13009325.title: DJ-1 promotes necroptosis of chondrocytes by the PTEN/PI3K-AKT signaling pathway
pmc-13009325.creator: Xiangyu Zu, Wenhan Fu, Hao Tang, Di Yang, Yi Ren, Yetian Li, Wei Huang, Qingli Luo, Jun Chang, Zongsheng Yin, Minmin Wu, Kunpeng Qin
pmc-13009325.description: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a common degenerative joint disease characterized by progressive cartilage degradation. Necroptosis has been recognized as a process closely associated with OA progression; however, its precise underlying mechanisms remain elusive. In this study, we found that the expression levels of DJ-1 and p-MLKL were significantly elevated in human OA cartilage tissue.

pmc-13238200.title: Reforming the cellular, molecular, and genetics course in a graduate biomedical science program: CIPP guided course evaluation
pmc-13238200.creator: Fazal Arain, Satwat Hashmi, Kulsoom Ghias, Ambreen Surti, Rehana Rehman
pmc-13238200.description: Background & Objective:Graduate programs in biological and biomedical sciences play a crucial role in developing competencies required for academic and research careers. Routine curricular evaluation of such programs is important to ensure their quality, impact and relevance. Cellular, Molecular and Genetic Sciences: Knowledge and Application (CMG) is one of the core courses of MPhil in Biological and Biomedical Sciences program.

pmc-13318850.title: Polydeoxyribonucleotide in Female Pattern Hair Loss: Current Evidence and Knowledge Gaps
pmc-13318850.creator: Nika Bakshi, Andrea Dai, Elham T Tabatabaei, Steven Daveluy
pmc-13318850.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). regenerative treatment in alopecia [1]. However, these findings were derived from a small sample size of a single study and require validation before they can be considered for clinical practice. This commentary revisits Lee et al.'s work in the context of growing interest in regenerative injectables and highlights the importance of further studies to confirm reproducibility before clinical application can be contemplated.

pmc-13361825.title: Parasite-Induced Changes in the Nervous System of the Shore Crab Hemigrapsus sanguineus
pmc-13361825.creator: Elena Kotsyuba, Vyacheslav Dyachuk
pmc-13361825.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Trematodes are a class of parasitic flatworms with complex life cycles involving multiple hosts. They can influence the physiology and behavior of their intermediate hosts to improve the efficiency of transmission to definitive hosts, including by increasing host mortality. However, the mechanisms of their effect on the crustacean nervous system leading to neuronal dysregulation and its consequences have not been sufficiently elucidated.
